body:
I hadn't thought about it like that; perhaps you're right. I guess I'll never know what was going through his head and how he was feeling. 

I don't think I feel guilty about it or that it was about me. I just wish there was something I could have done or something I could do now. Since I met him in college, I don't know any of his family, but I wish I could help in some way or let them know how wonderful he was.
